call.text: scripts/assemble.mjs stops listing src files by hand; a new scripts/site-closure.mjs computes them by following index.html references and relative module imports from index.html and sw.js, and returns exactly the ten files the list named.
A new scripts/site-imports.test.mjs, added to the npm test list in package.json, fails the build if any relative import in the built site does not resolve to a file.
Source changes are exactly those four files: assemble.mjs and package.json modified, site-closure.mjs and site-imports.test.mjs added.
The built site changes in exactly one file, data/catalog.json, and only at $.release.siteBuildId, because scripts/ files are hashed into that identity.
